name: LuGame: Lunchtime Games Club!
source:
LuGame, Lunchtime Games Club is a romantic comedy, slice-of-life visual novel starring a harem of beautiful nerdy girls!

When you and your childhood friend, Tifa are caught playing games on the school computers, student council president Stacey kicks you out.

You join the games club hoping to continue your peaceful, lazy school life, only to find there's only one other member - A little girl who pretends she's a robot?!
Together you'll play childish games, go on fun adventures and hot dates!

Enjoy an easygoing romantic comedy about meeting new friends, making memories and gamer girl romance!
translation:
《LuGame：午餐游戏社！》是一部浪漫喜剧、日常视觉小说，主角是一群漂亮又宅的女孩！

你和青梅竹马蒂法在学校电脑上玩游戏时，被学生会长史黛西赶了出去。

你加入游戏社，希望继续平静慵懒的校园生活，却发现社团只有另一名成员——一个假装自己是机器人的小女孩！？

和她一起玩幼稚游戏、踏上有趣冒险、进行火热约会！

享受认识新朋友、创造回忆，以及游戏女孩恋爱的轻松浪漫喜剧！
